Use the discovery package at /Users/me/Documents/globai-projects/educationalmanagementsystem/artifacts/outputs/prototype-reverse-engineering/deliverables/ to seed route list. evals.name: fail-redirect-loop-and-missing-postcss
evals.prompt: Smoke-probe the same React app, but the build is broken: /login redirects to itself in a loop AND postcss.config.js is missing so Tailwind directives aren't compiled. Routes from operator: ['/', '/login?returnUrl=/login', '/dashboard']. Write to /Users/me/Documents/globai-projects/educationalmanagementsystem/artifacts/outputs/runtime-validation/.
evals.expected_output: Detector 3 (network_anomaly) flags redirect_loop with severity=fatal on /login?returnUrl=/login. Detector 4 (css_sanity) flags css_not_compiled (heuristic 4a) AND styles_not_applied (heuristic 4b) on /. browser_status=FAIL. browser_errors.json sorted fatal→high. suggested_root_cause for each error gives a concrete fix hint. The runtime-validation gate can read browser_errors.json verbatim as failure_feedback to spawn code-development(scope_type=bug-fixing).

evals.name: repair-rerun-after-postcss-fix
evals.prompt: REPAIR the smoke at /Users/me/Documents/globai-projects/educationalmanagementsystem/artifacts/outputs/runtime-validation/. The postcss.config.js was added by the bug-fix loop. failure_feedback: 'target: detector:css_sanity — re-run the CSS sanity detector across all probed routes; the postcss.config.js fix should resolve css_not_compiled and styles_not_applied. Do not re-probe http or console — those passed last time.'
evals.expected_output: Same SESSION_ID reused. Phase A skipped (route_plan preserved from PRIOR_SMOKE). Phase B re-runs only Detector 4 across all routes_probed entries; loads detectors 1, 2, 3, 5 from PRIOR_SMOKE for those routes. Aggregated browser_errors recomputed: css_sanity entries removed, others preserved. If css_sanity now passes, browser_status flips to PASS. browser_errors.json overwritten. BROWSER-SMOKE-SPEC rewritten in place; BROWSER-SMOKE-AUDIT gets a '## Repair Pass 1' section.
